title: HierarchiRetina: code for a diabetic retinopathy screening and grading cascade with heterogeneous mixture-of-experts lesion segmentation
description:
Source code, notebooks and evaluation scripts for HierarchiRetina, a three-stage system for diabetic retinopathy: a ConvNeXt V2-L screening gate (Stage I), HSMoE-AUNet lesion segmentation and SwinHRUNetPP vessel segmentation (Stage II), and the LG-DRG lesion-guided grader (Stage III).

The script scripts/reproduce_paper_results.py recomputes every end-to-end number reported in the paper from the released per-image predictions.

Paper: HierarchiRetina: A Diabetic Retinopathy Screening and Grading Cascade with Heterogeneous Mixture-of-Experts Lesion Segmentation, preprint arXiv:2610.17933, submitted to the IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics.

Licences: the code is under the MIT licence. The per-image predictions in results/ are included under CC BY-NC 4.0, because the training datasets restrict commercial use. The trained weights (12 files, about 10 GB, also CC BY-NC 4.0) are not part of this archive; they are attached to the GitHub release v1.0, and scripts/fetch_weights.py downloads them and checks each SHA-256.
